stem_en: What is version control (e.g. Git)? Explain the specific difference between 'committing' code and 'pushing' code.
stem_bn: Version control (যেমন Git) কী? 'committing' code ও 'pushing' code-এর নির্দিষ্ট পার্থক্য ব্যাখ্যা করুন।
model_answer_en:
Version control is a system that records changes to files over time so a team can track history, work in parallel on branches, and recover any earlier version. Git is a distributed version control system: every developer has a full local copy of the repository plus its history.

Committing vs pushing:
• git commit records a snapshot of the staged changes into the LOCAL repository, with a message and a unique hash. It only affects your own machine; teammates cannot see it yet.
• git push uploads the commits that exist locally to a REMOTE repository (e.g. GitHub), updating the shared branch so others can fetch them.

So the flow is: edit → git add (stage) → git commit (save locally) → git push (share with the remote). You can make several commits offline and push them together later. A commit alone shares nothing with the team; a push is what publishes your committed work. (The reverse operations are git fetch/pull, which bring remote commits into your local repository.)
model_answer_bn:
Version control হলো এমন system যা সময়ের সাথে file-এর পরিবর্তন রেকর্ড করে, যাতে team history track করতে, branch-এ সমান্তরালে কাজ করতে এবং যেকোনো আগের version ফিরে পেতে পারে। Git একটি distributed version control system: প্রতিটি developer-এর কাছে repository ও তার history-র সম্পূর্ণ local copy থাকে।

Committing বনাম pushing:
• git commit staged পরিবর্তনের snapshot একটি message ও unique hash-সহ LOCAL repository-তে রাখে। এটি শুধু আপনার মেশিনে প্রভাব ফেলে; সহকর্মীরা এখনো দেখতে পান না।
• git push locally থাকা commit-গুলো REMOTE repository-তে (যেমন GitHub) পাঠায়, shared branch update করে যাতে অন্যরা তা fetch করতে পারে।

তাই প্রবাহ: edit → git add (stage) → git commit (locally save) → git push (remote-এ share)। আপনি offline-এ কয়েকটি commit করে পরে একসাথে push করতে পারেন। শুধু commit team-এর সাথে কিছু share করে না; push-ই committed কাজ প্রকাশ করে। (উল্টো operation হলো git fetch/pull, যা remote commit আপনার local-এ আনে।)

stem_en: Distinguish between size-oriented and function-oriented software metrics, with one example of each and one advantage/limitation.
stem_bn: Size-oriented ও function-oriented software metric-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য করুন, প্রতিটির একটি উদাহরণ ও একটি সুবিধা/সীমাবদ্ধতাসহ।
model_answer_en:
Software metrics quantify an attribute of the product or process. They fall into two families:

Size-oriented metrics are based on lines of code (LOC/KLOC). Derived measures include productivity = KLOC per person-month, quality = defects per KLOC, and cost per KLOC. Example: a 20-KLOC module built in 40 person-months gives 0.5 KLOC/PM.
• Advantage: easy to collect automatically once code exists.
• Limitation: LOC depends on language and coding style, and is unknown early; a verbose language inflates the count.

Function-oriented metrics are based on functionality delivered, measured in Function Points (FP) from external inputs, outputs, inquiries, internal logical files and external interface files. Derived measures include defects per FP and FP per person-month.
• Advantage: language-independent and estimable from the requirements, before any code.
• Limitation: counting FP needs training and some subjective complexity judgement.

In short, size metrics are simple but language-dependent and late; function metrics are earlier and language-neutral but need skilled counting.
model_answer_bn:
Software metric product বা process-এর একটি বৈশিষ্ট্য পরিমাপ করে। এরা দুই পরিবারে পড়ে:

Size-oriented metric lines of code (LOC/KLOC)-এর উপর ভিত্তি করে। প্রাপ্ত পরিমাপ: productivity = প্রতি person-month-এ KLOC, quality = প্রতি KLOC defect, ও প্রতি KLOC cost। উদাহরণ: 40 person-month-এ তৈরি 20-KLOC module দেয় 0.5 KLOC/PM।
• সুবিধা: code থাকলে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সহজে সংগ্রহযোগ্য।
• সীমাবদ্ধতা: LOC language ও coding style-নির্ভর, আগেভাগে অজানা; verbose language গণনা বাড়ায়।

Function-oriented metric delivered functionality-র উপর ভিত্তি করে, Function Point (FP)-এ মাপা হয় external input, output, inquiry, internal logical file ও external interface file থেকে। প্রাপ্ত পরিমাপ: প্রতি FP defect ও প্রতি person-month-এ FP।
• সুবিধা: language-নিরপেক্ষ এবং requirement থেকে, code-এর আগেই অনুমানযোগ্য।
• সীমাবদ্ধতা: FP গণনায় প্রশিক্ষণ ও কিছু subjective complexity বিচার লাগে।

সংক্ষেপে, size metric সরল কিন্তু language-নির্ভর ও দেরিতে; function metric আগে পাওয়া যায় ও language-নিরপেক্ষ কিন্তু দক্ষ গণনা দরকার।

stem_en: What is Software Configuration Management (SCM)? Describe its main activities and the role of a baseline.
stem_bn: Software Configuration Management (SCM) কী? এর প্রধান কার্যক্রম ও baseline-এর ভূমিকা বর্ণনা করুন।
model_answer_en:
Software Configuration Management (SCM) is the discipline of identifying, organising and controlling changes to the work products of a project throughout its life cycle, so that change is deliberate rather than chaotic.

Main SCM activities:
1. Configuration identification — name and define the configuration items (CIs): source code, documents, test cases, libraries.
2. Version control — store every version of each CI (e.g. in Git/SVN) so any version can be retrieved and parallel work merged.
3. Change control — a formal process: a change request is raised, evaluated by a Change Control Board for impact, approved or rejected, then implemented and verified.
4. Configuration auditing — check that the built system actually contains the approved CIs and changes.
5. Status accounting / reporting — record and report what changed, when, by whom and why.

Role of a baseline: a baseline is a CI (or set of CIs) that has been formally reviewed and agreed at a milestone (e.g. an approved SRS or a release build). Once baselined, an item can be changed only through formal change control. Baselines give a stable reference point: developers branch from a known-good state, and the team can always say exactly what is in a given release. SCM therefore protects integrity, supports teamwork and makes releases reproducible.
model_answer_bn:
Software Configuration Management (SCM) হলো project-এর work product-গুলোর পরিবর্তন তার life cycle জুড়ে চিহ্নিত, সংগঠিত ও নিয়ন্ত্রণ করার শৃঙ্খলা, যাতে পরিবর্তন বিশৃঙ্খল না হয়ে পরিকল্পিত হয়।

SCM-এর প্রধান কার্যক্রম:
1. Configuration identification — configuration item (CI) নামকরণ ও সংজ্ঞায়িত করা: source code, document, test case, library।
2. Version control — প্রতিটি CI-এর প্রতিটি version সংরক্ষণ (যেমন Git/SVN-এ) যাতে যেকোনো version ফিরে পাওয়া ও সমান্তরাল কাজ merge করা যায়।
3. Change control — একটি formal process: change request তোলা হয়, Change Control Board impact মূল্যায়ন করে, অনুমোদন/প্রত্যাখ্যান, তারপর বাস্তবায়ন ও verify।
4. Configuration auditing — নির্মিত system-এ অনুমোদিত CI ও পরিবর্তন সত্যিই আছে কিনা যাচাই।
5. Status accounting / reporting — কী বদলালো, কখন, কে, কেন তা রেকর্ড ও রিপোর্ট করা।

Baseline-এর ভূমিকা: baseline হলো এমন CI (বা CI-সেট) যা একটি milestone-এ (যেমন অনুমোদিত SRS বা release build) formally review ও সম্মত হয়েছে। Baseline হওয়ার পর item শুধু formal change control-এর মাধ্যমে বদলানো যায়। Baseline একটি স্থিতিশীল reference point দেয়: developer known-good অবস্থা থেকে branch করে, এবং team সবসময় বলতে পারে একটি release-এ ঠিক কী আছে। তাই SCM integrity রক্ষা করে, teamwork সমর্থন করে ও release পুনরুৎপাদনযোগ্য করে।

stem_en: Explain Function Point Analysis. For a system with 2 external inputs, 3 external outputs, 1 external inquiry, 1 internal logical file and 1 external interface file (all average complexity, weights 4, 5, 4, 10, 7) and a Total Degree of Influence of 35, compute the UFP, VAF and final FP.
stem_bn: Function Point Analysis ব্যাখ্যা করুন। 2টি external input, 3টি external output, 1টি external inquiry, 1টি internal logical file ও 1টি external interface file (সব average complexity, weight 4, 5, 4, 10, 7) এবং Total Degree of Influence 35 হলে UFP, VAF ও চূড়ান্ত FP হিসাব করুন।
model_answer_en:
Function Point Analysis (FPA) measures the functional size of software independently of the implementation language. It counts five function types — External Input (EI), External Output (EO), External Inquiry (EQ), Internal Logical File (ILF) and External Interface File (EIF) — each rated simple, average or complex and multiplied by a standard weight.

Step 1 — Unadjusted Function Points (UFP) = Σ(count × weight):
• EI: 2 × 4 = 8
• EO: 3 × 5 = 15
• EQ: 1 × 4 = 4
• ILF: 1 × 10 = 10
• EIF: 1 × 7 = 7
UFP = 8 + 15 + 4 + 10 + 7 = 44.

Step 2 — Value Adjustment Factor: VAF = 0.65 + 0.01 × TDI, where TDI is the sum of 14 general-system-characteristic ratings. VAF = 0.65 + 0.01 × 35 = 0.65 + 0.35 = 1.0.

Step 3 — Adjusted Function Points: FP = UFP × VAF = 44 × 1.0 = 44.

So the system is a 44-function-point application. FP can then feed estimation (e.g. effort = FP ÷ productivity in FP per person-month). The advantage is that FP is available from the requirements, before code; the limitation is that counting needs training and some judgement of complexity.
model_answer_bn:
Function Point Analysis (FPA) implementation language নির্বিশেষে software-এর functional size মাপে। এটি পাঁচটি function type গোনে — External Input (EI), External Output (EO), External Inquiry (EQ), Internal Logical File (ILF) ও External Interface File (EIF) — প্রতিটি simple, average বা complex রেট করে একটি standard weight দিয়ে গুণ করে।

ধাপ 1 — Unadjusted Function Points (UFP) = Σ(count × weight):
• EI: 2 × 4 = 8
• EO: 3 × 5 = 15
• EQ: 1 × 4 = 4
• ILF: 1 × 10 = 10
• EIF: 1 × 7 = 7
UFP = 8 + 15 + 4 + 10 + 7 = 44।

ধাপ 2 — Value Adjustment Factor: VAF = 0.65 + 0.01 × TDI; এখানে TDI হলো 14টি general system characteristic রেটিং-এর যোগফল। VAF = 0.65 + 0.01 × 35 = 0.65 + 0.35 = 1.0।

ধাপ 3 — Adjusted Function Points: FP = UFP × VAF = 44 × 1.0 = 44।

তাই system-টি একটি 44-function-point application। এরপর FP estimation-এ ব্যবহার করা যায় (যেমন effort = FP ÷ productivity, প্রতি person-month-এ FP-তে)। সুবিধা হলো FP code-এর আগে requirement থেকে পাওয়া যায়; সীমাবদ্ধতা হলো গণনায় প্রশিক্ষণ ও complexity-র কিছু বিচার লাগে।

stem_en: bKash is launching a new interest-bearing savings feature with a hard regulatory deadline. As project manager, draw up a risk management plan: identify three realistic risks, compute the risk exposure of one of them, and give the RMMM response for each.
stem_bn: bKash একটি নতুন সুদবাহী savings feature চালু করছে, যার একটি কঠোর regulatory deadline আছে। Project manager হিসেবে একটি risk management plan তৈরি করুন: তিনটি বাস্তবসম্মত risk চিহ্নিত করুন, একটির risk exposure হিসাব করুন, এবং প্রতিটির জন্য RMMM প্রতিক্রিয়া দিন।
model_answer_en:
Context: a mobile-financial-service (MFS) provider like bKash must ship a savings feature by a Bangladesh Bank deadline, so schedule and compliance risks dominate.

Risk register (probability, impact, exposure = p × impact):
| # | Risk | Type | p | Impact (BDT) | Exposure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Key backend engineer resigns mid-project | project | 0.30 | 2,000,000 | 600,000 |
| R2 | Regulatory interest-calculation rules change late | business | 0.40 | 3,000,000 | 1,200,000 |
| R3 | Peak-load failure on launch day | technical | 0.20 | 5,000,000 | 1,000,000 |

Worked exposure for R1: RE = 0.30 × 2,000,000 = 600,000 BDT. Ranking by exposure, R2 (1.2M) is addressed first, then R3 (1.0M), then R1 (0.6M).

RMMM responses:
• R2 (regulatory change): Mitigation — isolate the interest formula behind a configurable rules engine; keep a compliance liaison with Bangladesh Bank. Monitoring — review circulars weekly. Management — if rules change, update only the config and re-run the test suite.
• R3 (peak load): Mitigation — load-test at 3× expected TPS, add autoscaling. Monitoring — watch latency/error dashboards. Management — enable a graceful queue/fallback and a rollback plan for launch day.
• R1 (staff loss): Mitigation — cross-train a second engineer, document the design. Monitoring — track team morale and bus-factor. Management — have a vendor/contractor on standby.

Reserve: hold a contingency budget sized to the total exposure (~2.8M) and a schedule buffer on the critical path. The plan keeps the launch on the regulatory deadline while making the biggest risks visible and funded.
model_answer_bn:
প্রেক্ষাপট: bKash-এর মতো mobile-financial-service (MFS) provider-কে Bangladesh Bank-এর deadline-এ savings feature দিতে হবে, তাই schedule ও compliance risk প্রধান।

Risk register (probability, impact, exposure = p × impact):
| # | Risk | ধরন | p | Impact (BDT) | Exposure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | মূল backend engineer মাঝপথে পদত্যাগ | project | 0.30 | 2,000,000 | 600,000 |
| R2 | Regulatory interest-calculation নিয়ম দেরিতে বদল | business | 0.40 | 3,000,000 | 1,200,000 |
| R3 | Launch দিনে peak-load ব্যর্থতা | technical | 0.20 | 5,000,000 | 1,000,000 |

R1-এর worked exposure: RE = 0.30 × 2,000,000 = 600,000 BDT। Exposure অনুযায়ী আগে R2 (1.2M), তারপর R3 (1.0M), তারপর R1 (0.6M) সামলানো হয়।

RMMM প্রতিক্রিয়া:
• R2 (regulatory পরিবর্তন): Mitigation — interest formula একটি configurable rules engine-এর পেছনে আলাদা রাখা; Bangladesh Bank-এর সাথে compliance liaison। Monitoring — সাপ্তাহিক circular পর্যালোচনা। Management — নিয়ম বদলালে শুধু config update ও test suite পুনরায় চালানো।
• R3 (peak load): Mitigation — প্রত্যাশিত TPS-এর 3× load-test, autoscaling। Monitoring — latency/error dashboard পর্যবেক্ষণ। Management — graceful queue/fallback ও launch দিনে rollback plan।
• R1 (staff হারানো): Mitigation — দ্বিতীয় engineer cross-train, design document। Monitoring — team morale ও bus-factor track। Management — vendor/contractor standby।

Reserve: মোট exposure (~2.8M) অনুযায়ী contingency budget ও critical path-এ schedule buffer রাখা। plan-টি regulatory deadline-এ launch রাখে আর সবচেয়ে বড় risk-গুলো দৃশ্যমান ও funded রাখে।

stem_en: Describe the three team organisation structures (Mantei): Democratic Decentralised, Controlled Decentralised and Controlled Centralised. When is each suitable?
stem_bn: তিনটি team organisation structure (Mantei) বর্ণনা করুন: Democratic Decentralised, Controlled Decentralised ও Controlled Centralised। কোনটি কখন উপযুক্ত?
model_answer_en:
Mantei described three ways to organise a software team, differing in how decisions and communication flow.

1. Democratic Decentralised (DD): no permanent leader; coordinators are appointed for short tasks and decisions are by group consensus. Communication is horizontal. Suited to difficult, long, research-type problems where many ideas help, and to small expert teams. Weakness: harder to coordinate and hold accountable.

2. Controlled Decentralised (CD): a defined leader coordinates, but the team is split into semi-autonomous sub-groups that solve sub-problems and then decide within the group. Communication is horizontal within sub-groups and vertical to the leader. Suited to large problems that decompose cleanly.

3. Controlled Centralised (CC): a single top-level leader (e.g. a chief programmer) makes the key decisions and coordinates; communication is mostly vertical. Suited to simpler, well-understood projects with tight schedules, where speed and clear accountability matter more than creativity.

Rule of thumb: the harder and less certain the problem, the more decentralised the structure should be; the simpler and more time-critical, the more centralised.

3. Controlled Centralised (CC): একজন শীর্ষ নেতা (যেমন chief programmer) মূল সিদ্ধান্ত নেন ও সমন্বয় করেন; communication বেশিরভাগ উল্লম্ব। সরল, সুপরিচিত, কঠোর schedule-এর project-এ উপযুক্ত, যেখানে creativity-র চেয়ে গতি ও স্পষ্ট জবাবদিহি বেশি জরুরি।

stem_en: A real-time embedded controller is estimated at 40 KLOC. Using basic COCOMO for embedded mode (a=3.6, b=1.20, c=2.5, d=0.32), compute the effort (person-months), nominal development time (months) and average staffing. Show every step.
stem_bn: একটি real-time embedded controller 40 KLOC অনুমান করা হয়েছে। embedded mode-এর basic COCOMO (a=3.6, b=1.20, c=2.5, d=0.32) দিয়ে effort (person-month), nominal development time (month) ও গড় staffing হিসাব করুন। প্রতিটি ধাপ দেখান।
model_answer_en:
Given: embedded mode, KLOC = 40, a = 3.6, b = 1.20, c = 2.5, d = 0.32.

Step 1 — Effort: E = a × (KLOC)^b = 3.6 × 40^1.20.
40^1.20 = 40^1 × 40^0.20 = 40 × 2.0913 = 83.65.
E = 3.6 × 83.65 = 301.14 person-months.

Step 2 — Development time: D = c × E^d = 2.5 × 301.14^0.32.
301.14^0.32 = e^(0.32 × ln 301.14) = e^(0.32 × 5.7075) = e^1.8264 = 6.21.
D = 2.5 × 6.21 = 15.53 months.

Step 3 — Average staffing: N = E / D = 301.14 / 15.53 = 19.39 ≈ 20 persons.

Result: Effort ≈ 301.14 person-months, development time ≈ 15.53 months, average team ≈ 20 people. The embedded coefficients (a=3.6, b=1.20) make the effort much higher than organic or semi-detached for the same size, reflecting the tight constraints of real-time embedded work.

stem_en: A project has activities with durations and predecessors: A(3, none), B(4, A), C(2, A), D(5, B), E(1, C), F(2, D and E). Do the forward and backward pass, find the project duration, the critical path, and the slack of each non-critical activity.
stem_bn: একটি project-এর activity, duration ও predecessor: A(3, কিছু নয়), B(4, A), C(2, A), D(5, B), E(1, C), F(2, D ও E)। forward ও backward pass করুন, project duration, critical path ও প্রতিটি non-critical activity-র slack বের করুন।
model_answer_en:
Forward pass (ES = max EF of predecessors; EF = ES + duration):
| Act | Dur | ES | EF |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| B | 4 | 3 | 7 |
| C | 2 | 3 | 5 |
| D | 5 | 7 | 12 |
| E | 1 | 5 | 6 |
| F | 2 | max(12,6)=12 | 14 |
Project duration = EF(F) = 14.

Backward pass (LF = min LS of successors; LS = LF − duration), starting LF(F)=14:
| Act | LF | LS | Slack = LS−ES |
|---|---|---|---|
| F | 14 | 12 | 0 |
| D | 12 | 7 | 0 |
| E | 12 | 11 | 6 |
| B | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| C | 11 | 9 | 6 |
| A | 3 | 0 | 0 |

Critical path = activities with zero slack = A → B → D → F, length 3+4+5+2 = 14.
Non-critical: C and E each have 6 units of slack (they lie on the path A→C→E→F of length 8, which has 14−8 = 6 spare).

So the project takes 14 time units; C and E can each slip up to 6 units without delaying the project, but A, B, D and F cannot slip at all.

stem_en: A bank's ATM network averages 4 hours of downtime in a 30-day month. (a) Compute the system availability percentage. (b) If it processes 500 transactions/hour at a 0.50-taka fee, compute the revenue lost during the downtime.
stem_bn: একটি ব্যাংকের ATM network 30 দিনের মাসে গড়ে 4 ঘণ্টা down থাকে। (ক) system availability শতাংশ হিসাব করুন। (খ) ঘণ্টায় 500 transaction, fee 0.50 টাকা হলে downtime-এ হারানো আয় হিসাব করুন।
model_answer_en:
(a) System availability:
Total hours in the month = 30 days × 24 h = 720 hours.
Uptime = 720 − 4 = 716 hours.
Availability = uptime / total × 100 = 716 / 720 × 100 = 99.444… ≈ 99.44%.

(b) Revenue lost during downtime:
Transactions missed = rate × downtime = 500 tx/hour × 4 hours = 2,000 transactions.
Revenue lost = 2,000 × 0.50 taka = 1,000 taka.

Answer: availability ≈ 99.44%; revenue loss = 1,000 taka. (Note: 99.44% is far below the ~99.99% 'four nines' target for financial systems, so the 4 hours/month, though it loses only 1,000 taka in fees here, would breach a typical banking SLA.)
model_answer_bn:
(ক) System availability:
মাসে মোট ঘণ্টা = 30 দিন × 24 ঘণ্টা = 720 ঘণ্টা।
Uptime = 720 − 4 = 716 ঘণ্টা।
Availability = uptime / total × 100 = 716 / 720 × 100 = 99.444… ≈ 99.44%।

(খ) Downtime-এ হারানো আয়:
মিস হওয়া transaction = হার × downtime = 500 tx/ঘণ্টা × 4 ঘণ্টা = 2,000 transaction।
হারানো আয় = 2,000 × 0.50 টাকা = 1,000 টাকা।

উত্তর: availability ≈ 99.44%; আয়ের ক্ষতি = 1,000 টাকা। (লক্ষণীয়: আর্থিক system-এর ~99.99% 'four nines' লক্ষ্যের তুলনায় 99.44% অনেক কম, তাই মাসে 4 ঘণ্টা — যদিও এখানে fee-তে মাত্র 1,000 টাকা হারায় — সাধারণ banking SLA ভাঙবে।)

stem_en: Three activities on a path have (O, M, P) estimates in days: X(2, 4, 12), Y(4, 5, 12), Z(6, 9, 18). Using PERT, find each activity's expected time and variance, and the expected duration and standard deviation of the whole path.
stem_bn: একটি path-এর তিনটি activity-র (O, M, P) estimate দিনে: X(2, 4, 12), Y(4, 5, 12), Z(6, 9, 18)। PERT দিয়ে প্রতিটি activity-র expected time ও variance, এবং পুরো path-এর expected duration ও standard deviation বের করুন।
model_answer_en:
PERT: te = (O + 4M + P)/6; variance = ((P − O)/6)^2.

| Act | O | M | P | te = (O+4M+P)/6 | variance = ((P−O)/6)^2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| X | 2 | 4 | 12 | (2+16+12)/6 = 30/6 = 5 | (10/6)^2 = 1.667^2 = 2.78 |
| Y | 4 | 5 | 12 | (4+20+12)/6 = 36/6 = 6 | (8/6)^2 = 1.333^2 = 1.78 |
| Z | 6 | 9 | 18 | (6+36+18)/6 = 60/6 = 10 | (12/6)^2 = 2^2 = 4.00 |

Expected path duration = Σ te = 5 + 6 + 10 = 21 days.
Path variance = Σ variances = 2.78 + 1.78 + 4.00 = 8.56.
Path standard deviation = √8.56 = 2.93 days.

So the path is expected to take 21 days with a standard deviation of about 2.93 days; using the normal approximation, there is roughly a 68% chance it finishes within 21 ± 2.93 days (≈ 18.1 to 23.9 days).
